tex_content.html:
Proposition
↗ prop:tangent-bundle-admits-connection 1. ch5:5.16

On an oriented Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$, the Riemannian volume form $dV_g$ is parallel for the Levi-Civita connection.

Proof

\sketch Given $p\in M$ and $v\in T_pM$, choose a curve $\gamma $ with $\gamma (0)=p$, $\gamma '(0)=v$, and a parallel oriented orthonormal frame $(E_1,\ldots ,E_n)$ along it. Since $dV_g(E_1,\ldots ,E_n)=1$ and $D_tE_i=0$, the covariant derivative formula gives $\nabla _vdV_g=0$.

□
